input.query: send verification email for email change link

candidates.explanation: The new-email verification URL is built with the '/confirm-email' path, the same as the sign-up mail in userSignUp. The frontend page for that path calls POST auth/email/confirm (AuthService.confirmEmail). That endpoint only accepts users with inactive status, so it never applies the email change. The link should go to the page that calls auth/email/confirm/new (AuthService.confirmNewEmail), for example '/confirm-new-email'.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email'. This is the frontend route that calls POST /auth/email/confirm/new.
